title: Leaving Planet Suzaku
summary: The Alliance envoy is Mo Zhi, who knew Wang Lin as Zeng Niu and chose him for the crystal. When Zi Xin, now at mid Soul Transformation after taking Qian Feng's cultivation, threatens Wang Lin, he takes the title of Suzaku and passes it straight to Zhou Wutai, who becomes the fifteenth Suzaku, while Mo Zhi gives the Forsaken Immortal Clan a third of the planet for a nine-leaf skull every thousand years. Wang Lin now has both his and Wan'er's life souls, though his Soul Flag is badly damaged, and Xu Liguo has tamed the curved blade. Over a year the clan retreats northwest, Zi Xin and Liu Mei flee beyond the stars, and Wang Lin says goodbye at the Snow Domain and at the memorial tablets of his parents, Wang Tianshui and Zhou Yingsu. Situ Nan, living as a prince in the level-four Zhou country, travels with him past the Astral Wind and teaches him three killing techniques: the Annihilation Finger, the Demon Transformation Finger and the Yellow Springs Finger. Situ also explains the realms after Ascendant, and they reach the Trading Planet in the Kunxu star region, where in Mingmei City Wang Lin meets Bai Wei of the Heavenly Fate Sect, who invites him to his master's birthday. Wang Lin gives Situ a divine chariot, and they part, Situ for Planet Feng Luan and Wang Lin for Planet Tian Yun.
events: Mo Zhi reveals himself and asks why Wang Lin refused the Suzaku title
Wang Lin accepts the title and passes it to Zhou Wutai, the fifteenth Suzaku
The Alliance grants the Forsaken Immortal Clan a third of Planet Suzaku; Yun Quezi accepts
Xu Liguo shows off the tamed curved blade
A year passes; Wang Lin visits the Snow Domain and his parents' memorial tablets
Situ Nan teaches him the Annihilation, Demon Transformation and Yellow Springs Fingers
Situ explains Illusory Yin, Corporeal Yang and the three Nirvana realms
At the Trading Planet Wang Lin meets Bai Wei, gives Situ a divine chariot, and they part
introduced: Illusory Yin, Corporeal Yang, Nirvana Scryer, Nirvana Cleanser, Nirvana Shatterer (named)
cultivation: Zi Xin: mid Soul Transformation. Wang Lin: early Soul Transformation at the start, peak of mid Soul Transformation by the time he leaves. Bai Wei: mid Soul Transformation. After Ascendant come Illusory Yin and Corporeal Yang, then Nirvana Scryer, Nirvana Cleanser and Nirvana Shatterer.
